body: Close EXPAND leads with a final recommendation: choose takeover UX and pairing UX for MVP. Use explicit assumptions: account-authenticated presenter is available; anonymous mode is out of MVP; operator confidentiality/E2EE is not required in MVP. Reconcile QR fragment secret vs no bearer token and return a single safe protocol plus dead-end list.
summary: 원격 콘솔 페어링과 takeover 결론 확정
